title: Path In Zigzag Labelled Binary Tree
summary: Given the label of a node in an infinite binary tree where nodes are labelled in row order with a zigzag pattern (left-to-right in odd rows and right-to-left in even rows), return the sequence of labels from the root to that node.
statement: Given the label of a node in an infinite binary tree where nodes are labelled in row order with a zigzag pattern (left-to-right in odd rows and right-to-left in even rows), return the sequence of labels from the root to that node.
constraints: Rows alternate left-to-right and right-to-left labels in a perfect binary tree.
Return labels from root to the given node.
hints: At each level, mirror a zigzag label to its normal complete-tree position.
The mirrored parent equals (level minimum + level maximum - label)//2.
Append labels while climbing and reverse at the end.
The mirror formula accounts for row direction before taking the ordinary parent.
editorial: The mirror formula accounts for row direction before taking the ordinary parent.
